notes.title: Lazy Galaxy 2 is Fully Released Today!
notes.content:
[b]Our next game, Lazy Galaxy 2, is launching now![/b] 
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27023349/91d437ddbda34bdf03a86c2fdaee7ee925d5249f.png[/img]
Lazy Galaxy 2 is an idle/clicker game with base-building and RTS elements. It stayed in early access for more than 6 months and on full release, you can experience these new features:
- mod support
- idle combat
- late-game upgrades and improvements
As well as other bug fixes/balancing and quality of life improvements.

Get the game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1477950/Lazy_Galaxy_2/?utm_source=steam&utm_campaign=release_day
And as we are celebrating the Full Release of Lazy Galaxy 2, we are announcing discounts for all of our games!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27023349/07d79972df8ad4b704dde0c1059e0fa379b01f75.png[/img]

Thanks for playing our games and supporting us! Hope you'll enjoy Lazy Galaxy 2 as much as we do!

If you’d like to learn more about the game or want to hang out with devs and other Coldwild Games community members, you’re welcome to join us at: [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/coldwildgames]discord server.[/url]

Want to help us out? Consider spreading the word via Twitter, Reddit, etc. and leaving a review on Steam if you enjoyed the game!

Have a great rest of the week,
Elizabete and the rest of the Coldwild Games crew

notes.title: Luna’s Fishing Garden is OUT!
notes.content:
Hello, Coldwild Games players! The day has finally arrived — our next game, Luna’s Fishing Garden is here!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27023349/12465e093ab0941f83cf425b332cd7d643e5dc5f.gif[/img]

Grab a rod and get ready to unwind! You’ll enjoy:

[list]
[*] Catching fish (obviously) using two different play styles
[*] Planting trees and other greenery the way you want to make the Garden shine!
[*] Chatting with the Garden’s memorable inhabitants—just try not to insult any geckos!
[*] Delightfully colorful and lively pixel art
[*] Cheerful, catchy, original music
[*] Easter eggs for our Merchant of the Skies players 😎
[/list]

GET THE GAME HERE: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1477790/Lunas_Fishing_Garden]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1477790/Lunas_Fishing_Garden[/url]

We hope everything above brings you joy, peace, and maybe even some laughs (:
If you’d like to learn more about the game or want to hang out with devs and other Coldwild Games community members, you’re welcome to join us at: [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/coldwildgames]discord server[/url].

Want to help us out? Consider spreading the word via Twitter, Reddit, etc. and leaving a review on Steam if you enjoyed the game!

If you want to support us even more, consider picking up the game + OST bundle (which is totally awesome) or the whole Coldwild Games bundle (some of the games are on sale!).


Wishing you the best,
The Coldwild Games Team

notes.title: Frequent Flyer: 1.0.1 patch is out!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thanks for being patient! Due to your feedback, I was able to implement a few small improvements / bugfixes in the game.

Here's the changelist:
- "Stick"  controls added: can be enabled in settings. After that, the plane in the game will go in the direction your gamepad stick is pointing. 
- Overall improvements of gamepad controls: use A/B to boost/brake. Pause button on Xbox controller is also usable to bring in pause menu to review your missions / tasks.
- Fixed the issue when bottom exp / energy bar showed improperly on widescreen.
- Removed "Tweet" button :) I understand it has probably been annoying to some of you and I did not see much info about the game retweeted anyway.

If you find any issues with the new build - please do not hesitate to let me know and I'll try to fix it asap. I've tested it on all 3 platforms, but I'm just one man developer right now and some bugs could have gone through.

More than anything - thanks for letting me know about the issues, this allows me to improve the game and I sincerely appreciate that.

Cheers,
Vladimir
